title: [Bug] A3：ResolveBufferSelect 扩大 Mat 子视图物理尺寸，导致 Mat→Right TMOV 形状校验失败
body:
### 问题概述

一个物理尺寸 `256×64`、有效尺寸 `64×64` 的 Mat 子视图搬运到同样物理尺寸的 Right Tile 时，原始 PTO 可以进入编译流程，但 `PTOResolveBufferSelect` 把源操作数的物理行数恢复成父 Tile 的 384，随后触发 TMOV 源/目标尺寸不一致的校验错误。

已通过独立 PTO 文件复现，不依赖 PyPTO 运行时，也没有执行设备内核。应用侧可以显式使用带正确有效尺寸的 `TEXTRACT` 继续开发；没有修改或重建公共 SDK。

### 环境

- PTOAS：`914863ed3d0eb3e92a4433a4a706a86cabf4c91f`
- 目标：A3，`--pto-level=level3`
- 最初生成该 IR 的 PyPTO：`26e94e05627eb47710dcc214bae1774b8829df8a`
- 以下复现只需 PTOAS，不需要 NPU。

### 复现命令

将下方代码保存为 `repro.pto`，执行：

```bash
ptoas --pto-arch=a3 --pto-level=level3 --enable-insert-sync \
  --mlir-print-ir-after-failure repro.pto -o /tmp/repro.cpp
```

```mlir
module attributes {pto.target_arch = "a2a3"} {
  func.func @kernel(%arg0: !pto.ptr<f16>, %arg1: !pto.ptr<f16>, %arg2: !pto.ptr<f32>) attributes {pto.kernel_kind = #pto.kernel_kind<cube>} {
  %c0_i64 = arith.constant 0 : i64
  %c8192_i64 = arith.constant 8192 : i64
  %c16384_i64 = arith.constant 16384 : i64
  %c16_index = arith.constant 16 : index
  %c256_index = arith.constant 256 : index
  %c1_index = arith.constant 1 : index
  %c384_index = arith.constant 384 : index
  %c64_index = arith.constant 64 : index
  %c0_index = arith.constant 0 : index
  %a__ssa_v0_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg0, shape = [%c16_index, %c256_index], strides = [%c256_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf16>
  %b__ssa_v0_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg1, shape = [%c384_index, %c64_index], strides = [%c64_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf16>
  %out__ssa_v0_view = pto.make_tensor_view %arg2, shape = [%c16_index, %c64_index], strides = [%c64_index, %c1_index] {layout = #pto.layout<nd>} : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32>
  %lhs__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c16_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>
  %a__ssa_v0_pview = pto.partition_view %a__ssa_v0_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c16_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf16> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x64xf16>
  pto.tload ins(%a__ssa_v0_pview : !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x64xf16>) outs(%lhs__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>)
  %parent__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c8192_i64 valid_row = %c384_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=384, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>
  %b__ssa_v0_pview = pto.partition_view %b__ssa_v0_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c384_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf16> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<384x64xf16>
  pto.tload ins(%b__ssa_v0_pview : !pto.partition_tensor_view<384x64xf16>) outs(%parent__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=384, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>)
  %view__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c16384_i64 valid_row = %c64_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=none_box, fractal=512, pad=0>
  %slice_view = pto.subview %parent__ssa_v0[%c64_index, %c0_index] sizes [256, 64] valid [%c64_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=384, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0> -> !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=64, v_col=64, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>
  %left__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c16_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=left, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>
  pto.tmov ins(%lhs__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>) outs(%left__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=left, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>)
  %right__ssa_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c64_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=right, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=col_major, fractal=512, pad=0>
  pto.tmov ins(%slice_view : !pto.tile_buf<loc=mat, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=64, v_col=64, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>) outs(%right__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=right, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=col_major, fractal=512, pad=0>)
  %t__tmp_v0 = pto.alloc_tile addr = %c0_i64 valid_row = %c16_index valid_col = %c64_index : !pto.tile_buf<loc=acc, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=1024, pad=0>
  pto.tmatmul ins(%left__ssa_v0, %right__ssa_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=left, dtype=f16, rows=16, cols=256, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=512, pad=0>, !pto.tile_buf<loc=right, dtype=f16, rows=256, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=row_major, slayout=col_major, fractal=512, pad=0>) outs(%t__tmp_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=acc, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=1024, pad=0>)
  %out__ssa_v0_pview = pto.partition_view %out__ssa_v0_view, offsets = [%c0_index, %c0_index], sizes = [%c16_index, %c64_index] : !pto.tensor_view<?x?xf32> -> !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x64xf32>
  pto.tstore ins(%t__tmp_v0 : !pto.tile_buf<loc=acc, dtype=f32, rows=16, cols=64, v_row=?, v_col=?, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major, fractal=1024, pad=0>) outs(%out__ssa_v0_pview : !pto.partition_tensor_view<16x64xf32>)
  return
  }
}
```

### 实际结果

```text
error: 'pto.tmov' op expects mat-source tmov to use matching src/dst shapes
// -----// IR Dump After PTOResolveBufferSelect Failed (pto-resolve-buffer-select) //----- //
```

原始 TMOV 的类型为：

```text
src: Mat   [256,64], valid=[64,64]
dst: Right [256,64], valid=[?,?]   // alloc_tile 的有效尺寸操作数是 64,64
```

失败后的 IR dump 显示：

```text
"pto.tmov"(%27, %29) ... :
  (!pto.tile_buf<mat, 384x64xf16, valid=64x64, blayout=col_major, slayout=row_major>,
   !pto.tile_buf<right, 256x64xf16, valid=?x?, slayout=col_major>) -> ()
```

也就是说，源的物理形状由 `256×64` 变成了父 Tile 的 `384×64`，目标仍是 `256×64`。定位依据是失败 pass 的实际 IR；尚未判断全部同类视图是否受影响。

### 预期行为

对于需要保留父 Tile 步长的窗口，应生成等价且可编译的子区域搬运，例如保留父 Tile 与行偏移、转换为适用的 `TEXTRACT`；或者在前端给出明确的“不支持该子视图 TMOV”诊断。不能仅放松 TMOV 形状检查，否则可能把物理步长问题变成错误结果。

本例窗口的物理范围是父 Tile 的第 64～319 行，完全落在 384 行内；有效计算仅使用第 64～127 行。这个问题不涉及越界切片，也没有要求设备读取未初始化数据。

### 应用影响与相关 issue

在 CSA Indexer 的 GEMV 试验中，K256 的物理对齐与有效 K64 需要同时保留。这个问题阻碍了通过 Mat 切片加 move 表达 Right 输入。显式 TEXTRACT 写法已使完整应用通过 PyPTO/PTOAS 和二进制编译，但运行正确性及完整算子性能仍需单独验证。

已查重 PyPTO/PTOAS 的 `mat-source tmov`、TMOV/valid/shapes 等关键词。#1649 同样涉及 ResolveBufferSelect 扩大子视图，但作用于 Vector TGATHER indices；本例作用于 Mat→Right TMOV。另有 hw-native-sys/pypto#3132 的 Acc→Acc assemble 问题，地址空间和失败机制不同，分别保留复现。
